proofs.unique_partition_reason: Each tree edge is forced together: if its endpoints were separated, C+a would have the same local projection as positive C+ab on the a-side and as positive C on every other side, so the negative would be accepted. The tree edges force the listed k components, and exactly k nonempty blocks therefore give one partition.
proofs.regular_target_language: L_i = u_i E_i*; u_i is the projection of C on block i; E_i contains the declared center+leaf 2-symbol tree tiles.
